arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Shah argued the question is whether Congress abrogated tribal immunity in the Bankruptcy Code.
Mr. Shah stated that reading the phrase to include tribes is not wholly unreasonable.
Mr. Raynor argued the Code unequivocally abrogates the immunity of all governments, including tribes.
Mr. Rapawy argued tribes are governments because they exercise governmental authority and functions.

paragraphs: This case defines the legal boundary between tribal sovereignty and federal bankruptcy law. It determines whether tribes face financial liability in bankruptcy proceedings. The outcome shapes the balance of power between tribal nations and federal courts.
